sources._comment: PCHUB.UK (228,274 rows on 23 Oct 2026, a trade catalogue: 99,975 rows in 'PC Components>Other', spare parts, toner, POS, cables). Only products in the consumer folders of 'allowPaths' (folder names of merchant_category), never those of 'denyPaths', of the consumer brands (same list as Back to the Office) and without the business words. Every name is cut at 70 characters ('nameCutAt': the cut last word is taken off) and rrp_price is always price x 1.44 ('ignoreWasPrice': no fake discount). Data projectors (Epson EB, installation laser projectors), hotel TVs, photo paper, call-centre headsets and the makers' own replacement power supplies are out (dry run of 24 Oct 2026). Owner, 24 Oct 2026: as many as possible, if safe: more consumer brands, genuine ink and toner, laptop chargers, monitor and TV mounts, and from the catch-all folders ('looseFolders') only products whose name says what they are. Lessons L45, L46. Third dry run (24 Oct 2026): in the spare-part folders ('partsFolders': 'Other', 'Direktek') a name with letters missing ('DELL Opicl Scroll Mouse US') is out, and so is a product with no consumer folder whose name has a spare-part word ('partsNames'). Hotel TVs (folder 'Hospitality TVs', Samsung HG..) and network gateway/controllers are out; the same product twice in this shop is shown once, at its lowest price. Lessons L47. Fourth dry run (24 Oct 2026): HP 'Contract' toner, waste boxes, large-format ink and paper, business cameras and radio links, server cards and data-centre SSDs, and Dell's part abbreviations (ASSY, CVR ...) are out; a catch-all product needs a name that says something. Lessons L48.
